name: PT Klinko Karya Imaji Tbk
summary: PT Klinko Karya Imaji Tbk specializes in the production and global distribution of cleaning solutions, uniquely incorporating recycled textile waste materials. Their product line features items such as mats, mops, and napkins. The company primarily serves industrial manufacturers within diverse sectors including pharmaceutical, medical devices, microelectronics, and automotive. Founded in Gresik, Indonesia, in 2016, Klinko Karya Imaji Tbk maintains its core operations from this location.
